scope: Reviewed authored max-HP clamp semantics for a future piecewise curve adapter; not implemented in the current affine-only consumer.
semantics: The class inherits SpreadDamageWarhead and overrides InflictDamage.
It starts from HealthInfo.HP, caps at MaxReferenceHp when that value is positive, then floors at MinReferenceHp when that value is positive.
The clamped HP is multiplied by damage modifiers, authored Damage percent and inherited DamageVersus.
The source uses integer percentage application. Continuous coefficients describe nominal arithmetic only; actual hit truncation and splash modifiers remain separate.
next_implementation_constraint: Do not mislabel this as one global A+B*H curve. Preserve a separate clamped-HP component or emit explicit piecewise intervals, and retain any other selected channels.
